info.name: POS System - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for Point of Sale (POS) System with MERN Stack

Features:
- User Management & Authentication
- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- Customer Management (Loyalty & Credit)
- Product & Inventory Management
- Supplier & Company Management
- Purchase Orders & GRN
- Sales Management (Returns & Refunds)
- Reports & Analytics

Base URL: http://localhost:3000/api
